_doc: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-19 for road-to-a-brand-the-tree-can-check 6.3, before any run. Decision E8 fixed N = 30 brand-copy prompts across the six 6.1 readers, bar >= 95 % of reader runs Read the slot, and 0 slot reads on unrelated prompts; this file fixes the prompts and the unrelated set (10), which E8 left open. No prompt may be edited after the first run.

protocol.fixture: a scratch project outside this repository, with the package installed as a consumer and agents/context-spine/brand-voice.md present and schema-valid; the host's user scope must not carry this package's own rules (a clean HOME), per the in-repo probe trap
protocol.host: Claude Code, headless (`claude -p --output-format stream-json`), one fresh session per prompt
protocol.read_event: a Read tool call whose file_path ends with agents/context-spine/brand-voice.md, from the stream or the audit log; a Grep or Glob naming the path does not count
protocol.rate: reader runs with >= 1 read_event / 30; unrelated runs with >= 1 read_event must be 0
protocol.routing_check: a reader run counts toward the denominator whether or not its skill activated; the activated skill is recorded beside each run, because E8's revisit-if is that the fixtures do not route to the readers
